pcap checker is verifying the order of messages in pcap file.
Keywords contained in this module require the definition of expected messages.
Follow the rules when defining these messages:

Your messages should be defined as strings. Each awaited message should be in format like:
```commandline
    AwaitedMessage(
        name='SgNBAdditionRequestAcknowledge',
        find_by=[inspectors.HasInspector('x2ap.SgNBAdditionRequestAcknowledge_element')],
        
        # The found message can be checked by given cell:
        verify_by=[HasInspector('nr-rrc.physCellId', str(attach_cell_id))]
    )
```
You can also indicate a list of forbidden messages:
```commandline
forbidden_messages = [
    AwaitedMessage(
        name='SgNBModificationRequest',
        find_by=[HasInspector('x2ap.SgNBModificationRequest_element')],
        verify_by=[HasInspector('nr-rrc.scgFailureInfo_element')]
    ),
]
```

How to use pcap_checker in Python:

```python
from taf.rfrl.utilities.parsers.pcap_checker.checker import Checker, AwaitedMessage
from taf.rfrl.utilities.parsers.pcap_checker.inspectors import HasInspector
from taf.rfrl.utilities.parsers.pcap_checker.utils import PcapProvider


attach_cell_id = 111
pcap_file_path = path_to_your_logs.pcap

awaited_messages = [
    AwaitedMessage(
        name='SgNBAdditionRequest',
        find_by=[HasInspector('x2ap.SgNBAdditionRequest_element')]
    ),
    AwaitedMessage(
        name='SgNBReconfigurationComplete',
        find_by=[HasInspector('x2ap.SgNBReconfigurationComplete_element')]
    ),
    AwaitedMessage(
        name='SNStatusTransfer',
        find_by=[HasInspector('x2ap.SNStatusTransfer_element')]
    ),
]

forbidden_messages = [
    AwaitedMessage(
        name='SgNBModificationRequest',
        find_by=[HasInspector('x2ap.SgNBModificationRequest_element')],
        verify_by=[HasInspector('nr-rrc.scgFailureInfo_element')]
    ),
]


pcap_provider = PcapProvider()
checker = Checker(pcap_provider=pcap_provider)
checker.expect_flow(pcap_file=pcap_file_path,
                    display_filter='x2ap',
                    awaited_messages=awaited_messages,
                    forbidden_messages=forbidden_messages)
```

How to use pcap_checker with RobotFramework:

```robot
*** Settings ***
Library  taf.rfrl.utilities.parsers.pcap_checker.checker

*** Variables ***
${attach_cell_id}=  111
${pcap_file_path}=  path_to_your_logs.pcap
${awaited_messages}=
...                   SgNBAdditionRequest {
...                     findBy { has(x2ap.SgNBAdditionRequest_element) }
...                   }
...                   SgNBAdditionRequestAcknowledge {
...                     findBy { has(x2ap.SgNBAdditionRequestAcknowledge_element) }
...                     verifyBy { has(nr-rrc.physCellId:=${attach_cell_id}) }
...                   }
...                   SgNBReconfigurationComplete {
...                     findBy { has(x2ap.SgNBReconfigurationComplete_element) }
...                   }
...                   SNStatusTransfer {
...                     findBy { has(x2ap.SNStatusTransfer_element) }
...                   }
${forbidden_messages}=
...                   SgNBModificationRequest {
...                     findBy { has(x2ap.SgNBModificationRequest_element) }
...                     verifyBy { has(nr-rrc.scgFailureInfo_element) }
...                   }
${sn_status_transfer_messages}=
...                   SNStatusTransfer {
...                     findBy { has(x2ap.SNStatusTransfer_element) }
...                   }

*** Test Cases ***
Demo
    pcap_checker.Expect Flow        pcap_file=${pcap_file_path}
    ...                             display_filter=x2ap
    ...                             awaited_messages=${awaited_messages}
    ...                             forbidden_messages=${forbidden_messages}

    ${packets}=  pcap_checker.Get Packets        pcap_file=${pcap_file_path}
    ...                                          display_filter=x2ap
    ...                                          awaited_message=${sn_status_transfer_messages}
    Log  ${packets}  # For processing

    ${packets}=  pcap_checker.Count Packets      pcap_file=${pcap_file_path}
    ...                                          display_filter=x2ap
    ...                                          awaited_message=${sn_status_transfer_messages}
    Log  Count of SNStatusTransfer messages: ${packets}
```
